Manga 'Odoru Sennen Kazoku' Gets TV Anime
Production company Kuma announced a television anime adaptation of Akira Kazugai's Odoru Sennen Kazoku (Millennium Family) manga on Monday, revealing the lead cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and announcement promo. The anime series will air on TBS and other channels. Voice actor Rikuya Yasuda (Mayonaka Heart Tune) is starring as Theo. Supporting Cast Pair for 'Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku: Eureka Evrika' Announced
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hiro Yuuki's Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku (20th Century Electricity Catalog) light novel revealed a supporting pair of cast and an episode 4 visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime premiered on July 5 at 11:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX and exclusively worldwide on Netflix, followed by BS11, ABC TV, and TV Aichi. 'Wareware wa Uchuujin' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Song, Main Trailer
The official X (formerly Twitter) of the Wareware wa Uchuujin (We Are Aliens) revealed an additional pair of cast, theme song, main visual (pictured right) and the main trailer on Monday. The film is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on September 25. Actors Kemuri Matsui and Ten Yamasaki are joining the cast as Batahara and Konatsu, respectively.
